findings.note: AB 1116 (Elections: voter registration) lets a person without a California driver's license or state ID register online by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number, with the Secretary of State checking identity from that number, name and birth date. She voted yes on Assembly third reading (60 yes, 18 no, 1 not voting, passed).
subjects: online voter registration without state ID
